title: Context Passport
tagline: An digital passport for you to own your context across AI apps and for AI agents to know you better
description:
1. What problem are we solving?
Generative-AI apps forget who we are every time we open a new chat and cannot share context across products. Users repeat the same “about-me” and project background again and again, while the data they leave behind is trapped in platform silos.
2. Our solution in one sentence
ContextPassport turns a user’s long-term AI memory and topic-by-topic chat history into an encrypted, on-chain iNFT that any authorised AI can load—and, if the user wishes, monetise—instantly.
3. Key components & links
Persona iNFT: **ERC-7857 on 0G**
Storage Layer: **0G Storage gateway**
Compute Layer: **Fluence**
Front-end	Next.js 14, wagmi v2, shadcn/ui

5. Why it’s novel
On-chain cookie for AI – wallet connect = immediate context load, across any product.
Topic-level portability – granular capsules solve per-project continuity without data oversharing.
User-sovereign & forward-compatible – encrypted, versioned, mirrored; no vendor lock-in.
